blake3_implementation: Compact C11 scalar BLAKE3-256 derived from the official BLAKE3 reference implementation (BLAKE3-team/BLAKE3, c/ directory, CC0 public domain). It keeps the portable round function, the seven message schedules, 64-byte blocks, 1024-byte chunks, and the binary tree roll-up. It drops SIMD dispatch, keyed hashing, and derive-key. All helpers are static so the new translation unit adds only the three public ABI symbols.
record_wire_layout: 60-byte BLAKE3 record header: magic, seq, epoch, payload_len, 32-byte BLAKE3 digest of payload, 32-bit CRC32C of bytes [0..56).
